facts.fact: El Chaab says the National Digital Transformation Strategy was published in May 2025 after approval, naming no approving body or act.
El Chaab says the strategy was published in May 2025, as the framework uniting digitalisation efforts across sectors and public bodies; it states no period.

El Chaab credits the High Commission for Digitalisation with launching, between April 2024 and September 2026, projects including the Dzair Digital Services portal and a sovereign national cloud, measured against no strategy target.
